items.title: Gemini app rolls out 66 new regional voices on Android and iOS
items.summary: Google在Android及iOS版Gemini應用推出66種新的地區語音，包括美式、英式及印度英語，以及印地語、巴西葡萄牙語、印尼語和韓語等，並稱每種語音都按當地節奏與語調調整。用戶選定的語音會套用於整個應用，包括Gemini Live及聊天朗讀。
items.note: og:image is only the generic Google ‘G’ logo, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Gemini app adds a setting to keep chat history while opting out of model training
items.summary: Google更新Gemini應用，讓用戶可保留聊天記錄，同時選擇退出把記錄用作訓練生成式人工智能模型。公司稱若關閉新的History設定，往後對話會保存約兩個月，用於回覆、處理意見及安全用途；相關改動將於未來數周在全球陸續推出。
items.note: og:image is only the generic Google ‘G’ logo, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Gemini Notebook can turn research sources into interactive sites, Google says
items.summary: Google表示由即日起，Gemini Notebook可把資料來源轉成互動網站，用戶可在對話中輸入「make me a site」並描述需要的內容，例如互動周期表或數據儀表板。功能先在網頁版向18歲及以上的Gemini Notebook用戶（包括Google Workspace訂戶）全球推出，流動應用稍後推出。
items.imageAlt: Gemini Notebook interface showing a generated interactive periodic table and a prompt that says Make me a site to help me understand the periodic table

items.title: OpenAI expands free ChatGPT access to as many as 200,000 academic researchers
items.summary: OpenAI宣布擴大「ChatGPT for Academic Researchers」計劃，目標向全球最多20萬名研究人員免費提供ChatGPT。下輪申請將於11月23日（星期一）開放，以先到先得方式向合資格者發放5萬個新資助，受助人連同最多兩名合作者可使用ChatGPT Plus；公司稱整體目標較7月試點公布時增加一倍。
items.note: Official page gives the calendar date November 16, 2026 only; exact time is unknown. Direct curl to openai.com returned 403; page was read via WebFetch. New grants are ChatGPT Plus, not Pro, based on pilot usage.
items.imageAlt: OpenAI social card reading Academic Research, with a monarch butterfly, botanical line drawings, a river aerial photo and a glowing yellow shape on a blue background

items.title: OpenAI releases a CSAM image classifier and ChatGPT warnings that pause accounts for 24 hours
items.summary: OpenAI推出可偵測懷疑兒童性虐待內容（包括人工智能生成影像）的圖像分類器，經審核的機構可透過API免費使用。ChatGPT亦新增警示，會中斷尋找相關內容的嘗試、刪除該段對話，並暫停帳戶24小時，重複違規可導致更長限制，最終或關閉帳戶或向當局舉報。
items.note: Official page gives the calendar date November 16, 2026 only; exact time is unknown. TechCrunch later posted at 2026-11-16T17:00:00+00:00 (2026-11-17T01:00:00+08:00) covering the same announcement. Direct curl to openai.com returned 403; page was read via WebFetch.
items.imageAlt: OpenAI social card with the title Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse on a green and blue gradient

items.title: OpenAI study: surveyed scientists say the same research would take about 1.9 times as long without AI
items.summary: OpenAI經濟研究團隊分析「ChatGPT for Academic Researchers」夏季試點中1,819名科學家的超過58萬則科學相關訊息，並調查251名參與者。受訪者估計，在同等質素下，若沒有人工智能，相同研究工作需時約為1.9倍；在回答發現時間問題的人當中，98%預期人工智能會加快其領域的發現。
items.note: Official page gives the calendar date November 16, 2026 only; exact time is unknown. Companion to the Academic Researchers expansion post; this item is the research report and its figures. Direct curl to openai.com returned 403; page was read via WebFetch.
items.imageAlt: OpenAI social card titled Science at the Frontier, with a jellyfish, frog, yellow light bulb, plant cells and other science motifs

items.title: OpenAI adds computer-use agents, stronger clinical search and 20-plus plugins to ChatGPT for Healthcare
items.summary: OpenAI為ChatGPT for Healthcare推出電腦操作代理、經改進的臨床搜尋，以及超過20個新的醫療插件，並稱電腦操作代理及改進後的臨床搜尋即日起在符合工作區設定的情況下提供。公司表示，與ChatGPT for Healthcare分享的內容不會用來訓練模型。
items.note: Official page gives the calendar date November 16, 2026 only; exact time is unknown. A companion post, Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams, was published the same day. Direct curl to openai.com returned 403; page was read via WebFetch.

items.title: OpenAI signs embedded-assessment agreements with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire
items.summary: OpenAI與Apollo Research、METR、Transluce及Goodfire四家獨立評估機構簽署協議，展開第一階段「嵌入式評估」，讓評估人員在較長時間內深入取用內部模型與系統，以評估對齊情況及安全措施成效。公司稱此安排亦配合其在白宮超級智能協議下接受獨立安全評估的承諾。
items.note: Official page gives the calendar date November 16, 2026 only; exact time is unknown. Direct curl to openai.com returned 403; page was read via WebFetch.

items.title: Hugging Face routes language-model Inference Providers through OpenRouter
items.summary: Hugging Face宣布把Inference Providers的語言模型請求改由OpenRouter路由，按即時價格、速度及可靠性選擇供應商，若首選失敗會在同一請求內改試另一家。現有程式碼及Hugging Face token仍可使用，公司稱不會在供應商價格之上加價；圖像、影片及音訊生成則維持直連，不經OpenRouter。

items.title: Hong Kong launches new Smart Silver round and Robots in the Community pilot
items.summary: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東11月16日喺數碼港主持啓動禮，數字政策辦公室宣布新一輪「友智識」社區數碼共融計劃同「機器人走入社區」試驗計劃，將分別於2026年12月及2027年1月展開。當局會向地區團體免費借出人形機器人「友智寶」，以提升公眾對具身智能嘅認識；新一輪「友智識」推行機構增至18個、支援點超過90個，並會覆蓋鄉郊同離島，期望惠及超過40萬人次。
items.note: English GIA issued at HKT 19:25 on 16 Nov 2026; matching Chinese release is P2026111600590 (same time and photo). Official speech release P2026111600493 (issued HKT 16:20) adds that applications are already open and the first round closes on Friday 20 November. RTHK (1878006, 17:03 HKT) reports the opposite rollout order (robots in December, Smart Silver in January); this item follows the official GIA wording, which assigns December 2026 to the new Smart Silver round and January 2027 to the robot pilot. First-round Smart Silver figures (12 organisations, 40 help desks, over 250,000 elderly participants since 2024) are from the same official releases.
items.imageAlt: Innovation and Technology Secretary Sun Dong speaking at a podium in front of a backdrop showing a humanoid robot illustration and his title

items.title: Hong Kong university teams win 26 Challenge Cup awards, including AI and robotics projects
items.summary: 第十五屆「挑戰杯」中國大學生創業計劃競賽全國總決賽結束後，由本港七所資助大學及香港都會大學組成嘅香港代表隊合共奪得3項全國特等獎、7項一等獎同16項二等獎，範疇包括生物醫學、人工智能精準醫療、機器人及智慧建築科技。文匯報指當中理大「面向AI智算中心的Micro-LED超並行光互連」同城大「Hopcopter」飛跳混合機器人均屬特等獎項目；港大、中大、理大同城大並獲「優勝杯」。
items.note: Page timestamp is 2026-11-16 04:30:02 (Hong Kong). The finals themselves ran 30 Oct–3 Nov in Dalian; this is the results write-up becoming public in the 48-hour window and was not in yesterday’s batch. HKU’s own 15 Nov page (https://lead.hku.hk/tc/article/2026/11/hku-teams-capture-one-grand-prize-and-three-second-prizes-at-national-finals-of-the-15th-challenge-cup-china-undergraduate-entrepreneurship-competition/) confirms HKU’s special prize plus three second prizes, including the AI organoid platform ModelBio and the multi-agent urban-planning project BuildMind AI; time on that HKU page is not stated.
items.imageAlt: A University of Hong Kong student team posing with the university flag in front of a 15th Challenge Cup competition banner

items.title: NVIDIA puts a four-node DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit on sale at SC26
items.summary: NVIDIA喺芝加哥超級計算會議SC26推出DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit，由四部DGX Spark以ConnectX-7網絡組成環形叢集，合共提供512GB記憶體同20TB NVMe儲存，官方寫明展覽同期已經公開發售。公司表示，DGX Spark產品同線材可向Acer、ASUS、Dell、GIGABYTE、HP、Lenovo、MSI等OEM合作夥伴，以及NVIDIA Marketplace購買；用於科學計算嘅HPC SDK操作指引則仍屬「即將推出」，頁面並無標出套件售價。
items.note: article:published_time is 2026-11-16T23:00:05+00:00, which equals 2026-11-16T15:00:05-08:00 and 2026-11-17T07:00:05+08:00. Individual DGX Spark units were already on sale in earlier batches; what is new is the four-node HPC Developer Kit, described as on display at SC26 and available for sale. No price is stated on the page, so none is quoted. The HPC SDK playbook is explicitly 'coming soon' and is not treated as already shipping.
items.imageAlt: Four compact beige computers stacked on a desk and linked by cables, beside a coffee mug and a pen

items.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma raises $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation
items.summary: 網絡安全人工智能初創Corma宣布獲得由NEA領投、估值達10億美元的1.25億美元A輪融資。TechCrunch引述公司稱，連同此輪共籌得1.85億美元，出資者包括Sequoia Capital、Khosla Ventures及Coatue；公司於8月走出隱身階段。
items.note: article:published_time is 2026-11-16T23:32:32+00:00 (3:32 PM PST Nov 16 = 07:32:32 HKT Nov 17). The TechCrunch page og:image is credited as ‘TechCrunch / AI generated’ and is omitted. A BusinessWire release with the same figures was blocked (403) in this environment.

items.title: CNBC: Nvidia board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO
items.summary: CNBC引述一名知情人士指，Nvidia董事會目前並無考慮讓黃仁勳重返行政總裁職位，而是聚焦對其行為的調查，並已委託律師樓Wachtell Lipton了解有否損害國家安全或公司機密。報道並指特朗普周一表示對黃仁勳復職持開放態度；一項要求復職的網上請願已獲約18萬個簽名。
items.note: NEW vs yesterday’s FT ‘discussed returning’ and Bessent ‘dramatic shakeup’ items: the new facts are the board’s reported stance, the Wachtell Lipton probe, Trump saying he is open to a return, and the petition signature count. The board position comes from an unnamed person familiar with the matter, not an official Nvidia statement; a representative for Huang declined to comment. AP/PBS later reported Trump saying he ‘would certainly not mind’ and that Huang ‘learned a big lesson,’ and also said a person familiar with the board’s thinking told AP the board is not currently considering his return.
items.imageAlt: Jensen Huang in a black leather jacket speaking into a handheld microphone against a pale blue background

items.title: AMD completes World Labs acquisition; Fei-Fei Li joins as EVP and chief scientist
items.summary: AMD宣布已完成收購World Labs，並任命李飛飛為執行副總裁兼首席科學家，直接向行政總裁蘇姿丰匯報。公司稱World Labs開發可創建及模擬互動三維環境的人工智能模型，以及機械人學習與模擬技術，團隊將繼續推進基礎模型研究，並與AMD工程師合作。
items.note: Follow-up to the Nov 4 item that AMD had announced deals to acquire World Labs and Taalas. What is new: the World Labs transaction has closed, and Fei-Fei Li’s AMD title (executive vice president and chief scientist, reporting to Lisa Su) is confirmed.
items.imageAlt: Black social graphic with the AMD and World Labs logos over a network-like globe illustration

items.title: ElevenLabs agrees to acquire Japanese voice-AI lab Kotoba
items.summary: ElevenLabs宣布收購日本語音人工智能實驗室Kotoba，表示希望加快在日本這個全球第四大經濟體的語音代理及介面應用。Kotoba由Noriyuki Kojima及Jungo Kasai於2023年創立，其Koto模型用於日語語音合成、語音辨識及同聲傳譯；交易預計於2026年第四季稍後完成，仍須通過慣常監管審批。
items.note: JSON-LD datePublished is 2026-11-16T12:00:00.000Z. The acquisition is announced, not yet closed.
items.imageAlt: Selfie of three smiling men standing in front of a brick wall, used as the ElevenLabs announcement social image

items.title: Microsoft says it is the first provider approved to support NATO RESTRICTED cloud and AI workloads
items.summary: Microsoft宣布成為首家其雲端與人工智能基礎設施及生產力服務，獲批准支援NATO RESTRICTED（NR）工作負載的供應商，涵蓋Azure與Microsoft 365。公司稱批准由西班牙國家安全當局發出，以符合須由成員國驗證的要求，並已正式向北約數碼政策委員會報告。
items.note: JSON-LD datePublished is 2026-11-16T09:04:15+00:00; dateModified is 2026-11-16T11:37:46+00:00. No usable article og:image (only a generic Microsoft logo), so imageUrl is null.

items.title: U.S. Commerce BIS issues an interim rule on remote access to advanced AI chips and servers
items.summary: 美國商務部工業與安全局（BIS）11月16日公布臨時最終規則，指該規則由財政部及國家安全委員會撰寫並指示發布，旨在防止有關方面透過第三國數據中心的遠端運算安排，繞過對先進超級智能芯片與伺服器的現有限制。
items.source: U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security
items.note: Official release is dated November 16, 2026, for immediate release; exact time is unknown. Page image is only a U.S. flag icon, so imageUrl is null. CNBC (published 2026-11-16T13:47:23+00:00 / 2026-11-16T21:47:23+08:00) quoted the rule as also requiring licenses for advanced semiconductors to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand or Brazil. That country list is not in the short BIS press release and is not used in the summary.

items.title: SAP completes acquisition of AI work-intelligence company TechWolf
items.summary: SAP宣布已完成收購人工智能工作智能平台TechWolf，預期TechWolf會成為SAP SuccessFactors產品組合的智能核心。公司稱TechWolf的專有context graph將作為有關工作、技能規劃及人才管理的代理查詢依據層。
items.note: Official SAP post is dated November 16, 2026 only; exact time is unknown. og:image is a generic Getty stock photo of a woman holding a laptop, so imageUrl is null. The SAP page notes the press release was created with AI assistance and reviewed by editors. Deal price is not stated.

items.summary: CNBC報道，Anthropic預計喺11月18日（星期三）傍晚為首次公開招股定價，並於11月19日（星期四）喺納斯達克以代號ANT開始買賣。是次擬發行8.25億股A類股份，暫定每股70至78美元；按現時價格區間，集資額將超過640億美元，公司估值約1.405萬億美元，最多兩成股份擬面向零售投資者。
items.note: article:published_time 2026-11-16T14:22:24+0000 equals 9:22 AM EST / 22:22 HKT on 16 Nov, after yesterday’s batch. This is a follow-up to the Nov 15 item on the book being six times oversubscribed and the earlier $70–$78 / 825 million share range: what is new here is the expected pricing evening (18 Nov), Nasdaq debut date (19 Nov), ticker ANT, up to 20% retail, and CNBC’s range-based figures of more than $64 billion proceeds and a $1.405 trillion valuation. The IPO has not yet priced; dates and valuation are as CNBC stated ('expects' / 'at the current range'). Investopedia the same day also said the price is expected Wednesday evening with trading Thursday; its Bloomberg-attributed 'seven times' demand figure is not used because it conflicts with the earlier Reuters 'six times' report and was not in the CNBC key facts relied on here.
items.imageAlt: A smartphone displaying the Anthropic name, held in front of a screen with the letters IPO
